# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]

hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.

to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need

across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

parasitic worm infestations. Although Albendazole is mainly used in cattle and sheep, it is found
effective in cats and dogs as well. It is also used in ratite birds and swine to flagellate
parasites and tapeworms.

industries worldwide since 1885.

international, family-owned business built on quality, reliability and long-term partnerships.

We pay respect to both by constantly refining the distribution.

###### Welcome to Evologics

# Committed.

***Evologics***  is a surgical biologics distributor focused on human tissue allografts and related
products. We work with physicians, hospitals, and surgical centers to provide access to products for
surgical applications consistent with their official labeling and regulatory status.

***Evologics*** is proud to partner with industry leaders that have created and practice only the
highest bone and tissue sterilization processes. Using processes like PASCO2^{®}, our products are
sterilized while preserving biologic integrity, ensuring only high-quality bone, tissue and
allografts.

[ DOWNLOAD CATALOG ][68]

###### Our Values

## Safety, innovation and service.

###### 01.

##### Safety

Guided by our core values of accountability, precision, and transparency, we foster a culture where
safety is everyone’s priority. We are committed to protecting the health and well-being of patients,
partners, and communities by ensuring the highest standards of safety across every aspect of our
operations.

###### 02.

##### Innovation

We make lives better by combining our product innovations with compassion, ensuring healthcare
providers receive only the best products for their patients. By embracing cutting-edge technology
and creativity, we aim to improve patient outcomes, and create new standards in safety and standard
of care.

###### 03.

##### Service

We deliver exceptional service that consistently exceeds expectations, forging long-lasting, strong
relationships with our partners. We are dedicated to fostering trust, reliability, collaboration and
responsiveness with every interaction, empowering healthcare providers while improving patient
outcomes.

###### Our Products

## Committed to Quality

Evologics offers a wide array of products, including amnion, soft tissue allografts, bone and more
for a wide array of specialties, including spine, orthopedics, sports medicine, ophthalmology,
cosmetic surgery, podiatry and wound care.

##### EvoPatch Amnion

Minimally Manipulated Amniotic Tissue that can be used in open incision, laparoscopy and/or robotic
surgery procedures

##### Demineralized Bone Matrix

Available in multiple sizes to address a a wide array of procedures, including foot and ankle,
trauma and extremities, knees, hips, craniomaxillofacial, spine and more.

##### DBM Fiber

Demineralized cortical bone fibers that are entangled and shaped into sizes engineered to complement
specific surgical applications.

##### Bone and Tendon Allografts

Hard and soft allografts in a variety of configurations for most surgical applications.

###### Our Purpose

*“At Evologics, we understand successful business depends on a successful team. With the perfect
team, we continue to strive for excellence, providing healthcare professionals with products that
make people live better, healthier lives. We care more – and that’s what makes the difference.”*

Michael Crescenzo

###### Welcome to Evologics

# Committed.

***Evologics***  is a surgical biologics distributor focused on human tissue allografts and related
products. We work with physicians, hospitals, and surgical centers to provide access to products for
surgical applications consistent with their official labeling and regulatory status.

***Evologics*** is proud to partner with industry leaders that have created and practice only the
highest bone and tissue sterilization processes. Using processes like PASCO2^{®}, our products are
sterilized while preserving biologic integrity, ensuring only high-quality bone, tissue and
allografts.

[ DOWNLOAD CATALOG ][68]

###### Our Values

## Safety, innovation and service.

###### 01.

##### Safety

Guided by our core values of accountability, precision, and transparency, we foster a culture where
safety is everyone’s priority. We are committed to protecting the health and well-being of patients,
partners, and communities by ensuring the highest standards of safety across every aspect of our
operations.

###### 02.

##### Innovation

We make lives better by combining our product innovations with compassion, ensuring healthcare
providers receive only the best products for their patients. By embracing cutting-edge technology
and creativity, we aim to improve patient outcomes, and create new standards in safety and standard
of care.

###### 03.

##### Service

We deliver exceptional service that consistently exceeds expectations, forging long-lasting, strong
relationships with our partners. We are dedicated to fostering trust, reliability, collaboration and
responsiveness with every interaction, empowering healthcare providers while improving patient
outcomes.

###### Our Products

## Committed to Quality

Evologics offers a wide array of products, including amnion, soft tissue allografts, bone and more
for a wide array of specialties, including spine, orthopedics, sports medicine, ophthalmology,
cosmetic surgery, podiatry and wound care.

##### EvoPatch Amnion

Minimally Manipulated Amniotic Tissue that can be used in open incision, laparoscopy and/or robotic
surgery procedures

##### Demineralized Bone Matrix

Available in multiple sizes to address a a wide array of procedures, including foot and ankle,
trauma and extremities, knees, hips, craniomaxillofacial, spine and more.

##### DBM Fiber

Demineralized cortical bone fibers that are entangled and shaped into sizes engineered to complement
specific surgical applications.

##### Bone and Tendon Allografts

Hard and soft allografts in a variety of configurations for most surgical applications.

###### Our Purpose

*“At Evologics, we understand successful business depends on a successful team. With the perfect
team, we continue to strive for excellence, providing healthcare professionals with products that
make people live better, healthier lives. We care more – and that’s what makes the difference.”*

Michael Crescenzo

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Welcome to Flagship

FLAGSHIP BIOTECH INTERNATIONAL PVT. LTD. is fully integrated Pharmaceutical company with an
established presence across the globe in more than 45 countries.

The company is headquartered in India - Mumbai.

We are the fastest growing Indian pharmaceutical company engaged into Manufacturing and Marketing a
broad range of pharmaceutical preparations globally.

We believe that our competitive advantage in the International Market lies in our established
presence in all major therapeutic areas including Oncology, Anti-Diabetic, Cardiology, Pain and
Analgesics, Gynecology, Anti-infectives, Vitamins, Minerals, Nutrients, Gastro-Intestinal,
Anti-Osteoporosis, Anti-Malarial, Immunosuppressant, Anti-Bacterial, Anti- Asthmatics, Anti-Allergy
etc.

We provide affordable and quality medicines across the world, regardless of Geographic and Socio
Economic barriers.

Flagship Biotech International has set benchmarks for Pharmaceutical Manufacturing and achieved a
Marketing Excellence in the Branded Generics- Ethical, API, Formulations, OTC & Institutional
segments globally and has emerged as a respectable name in the Global Pharmaceutical and Healthcare
Arena.

[api]

Manufacturing

Flagship Biotech International provides the advanced manufacturing capabilities and processes that
create special quality of Generic Products.

The reputation of our company is built on Manufacturing and R&D facilities that are designed to meet

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves

orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

countries.

[ ][27]

products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

# Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad
range of pharmaceutical formulation to cope with the necessity of ailing humanity. With its
headquarter at Mumbai (India), Healthy Life Pharma holds expertise in offering different
formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,
ointments etc.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is the flagship company of Shah Group, founded by Mr. Shah in 1976.
An encouraging leader and inspiring personality, Mr. Shah has continuously looked forward to shape
the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

Having three decades of experience, Healthy Life Pharma is a WHO recognized organization, which has
certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

## Formulation & Bulk Drugs

Tablets

Available for variety of applications in different forms such as uncoated, sugar coated, film
coated, chewable and more.

What makes it different

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

[Browse the catalog by category and country →][8]
* Verified at the source
  
  Matched to official business registries (SIREN, CVR, RCCM and dozens more) or protected origin
  marks like PDO, GI and Genuine Jersey, not a self-declared badge.
* Sorted by category and country
  
  Find a specific product in a specific market instead of scrolling an endless, unfiltered list.
* Reachable even without a website
  
  Small makers surfaced through public registries and social profiles, with the source of every
  listing shown so you can check it yourself.

Matching engine

## Matching that explains itself

Every distributor is scored 0 to 100 against a manufacturer's offer on seven weighted criteria, with
a plain-language rationale, not a black box.
* 22%
  
  Country coverage
  
  Share of the manufacturer's target markets the distributor actively covers.
* 20%
  
  Category match
  
  Whether the distributor specialises in the offer's product category.
* 16%
  
  Sales channels
  
  Overlap between the requested sales channels and the distributor's channels.
* 13%
  
  Minimum order fit
  
  How comfortably the distributor's order capacity meets the minimum.
* 12%
  
  Certification fit
  
  Required certifications the distributor already holds.
* 9%
  
  Existing network fit
  
  Customer types served, brand portfolio size, partner-type match, and years in distribution.
* 8%
  
  Trade-agreement fit
  
  Preferential trade arrangements between the offer's target markets and the distributor's coverage
  (EAEU, EU, ASEAN, USMCA, CPTPP, AfCFTA, bilateral FTAs).

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of

opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated

ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. 

Throughout 2025, we continued to improve  our environmental performance, focusing specifically on
mitigating our emissions and establishing a more robust approach to water management, particularly
in the water scarce countries where we operate. As an example, we established water stewardship and
absolute CO2 emission reduction KPIs that link directly to Executive remuneration.

We also opened a new 1MW solar park in Jordan, and have plans to go much further in the coming
years.

Finally, we also spent 2025 continuing to focus on ethics and transparency across our value chain,
and taking serious measures to safeguard fundamental human rights both in the upstream and
downstream parts of our business. 

This year, for the first time we asked our key suppliers to rate us on how well we work with them,
and how we uphold our own Code of Conduct.

We believe that our high-quality medicines should reach everyone who needs them . This is why we
focus on acting responsibly, that means advancing health and wellbeing, empowering our people,

downstream parts of our business.

and how we uphold our own Code of Conduct.

The government's decision to reduce GST rates is a commendable step towards enhancing affordability
and supporting public welfare.

Starting 22nd September 2025, we’ve lowered the prices of our products to match the recent GST rate
cut. This change shows our commitment to making healthcare more affordable.

All partners must bill at the new prices and make sure customers get the full benefit of the GST
reduction.

# Welcome to ISKON REMEDIES

### WHO / GMP / GLP / ISO Certified Manufacturing Company

**Best Dry / & Liquid Injections Manufacturer in India** - Building on the years of experience and
dedication to improve the health quality, Iskon Remedies ‘the top Injection and Eye Drops
Manufacturer support the customers in best possible way. Through delivering quality drugs we are
also supporting the health by providing the highly effective products manufacutred in WHO / GMP /
GLP / ISO Certified Manufacturing Units. Iskon Remedies is working every single day to meet the
medical requirements by addressing the real-world challenges for all living beings. The Range of
Injections and eye drops manufactured at Iskon Remedies is diverse and meet all quality parameters.

We Exclusively Deal in Manufacturing of all type of (Dry and Liquid Injectables) - Betalactum,
Non-Betalactum, Cephalosporins, Carbapenems, Liquid Injectables, Penicillin Injections, Eye/Ear/
Nasal Drops, and Sprays Currently, the Company manufactures more than 500+ products & molecules,
under different brand names for parties all over India, which are tested at our own In House Quality
Control Laboratories, at both the plants. The companies approach us for liquid injections / [Dry
injections ][28]and eye drops manufacturing.

With the realization of a vision of **Mr. Gaurav Goyal (Managing Partner)**, ISKON REMEDIES is a
leading name in the pharmaceutical industry today. We come in the list of[ top Injection
Manufacturing companies in India][29]. ISKON REMEDIES operates fully integrated manufacturing
facilities based at **KALA-AMB (Himachal Pradesh)**, India. Our Corporate Marketing Office is
located at Panchkula (H.R) India, with two Manufacturing Plants situated at Kala-Amb (Just at a
distance of 60KM from Chandigarh) in the names of ISKON REMEDIES since 2005. Iskon Remedies is an
ISO Certified Company dedicated to manufaturing highest quality products using ultra-modern
facilitated technology according to **WHO Guidelines in GMP / GLP Certified Manufacturing Units**.

With a vision of providing high quality and affordable products to the society, ISKON REMEDIES has
achieved a leading position in the field of manufacturing pharmaceutical formulations for both
Domestic & Export Markets. We manufacture all kinds of pharmaceutical injectables at the best prices
of the industry and within a stipulated time all the orders are being executed strictly as per the
commitments to the Customers. Being a customer-oriented company we never compromise on quality,
which has enabled it to make a niche position for itself in the industry.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

## What is Cloud Based GST, Billing & Accounting Software?

A cloud based billing software allows business to handle all their invoicing, keep tabs on payments,
and securely manage their financial information on the internet. With 32+ years of expertise,
trusted by over 10+ million businesses across every trade. Our cloud-based GST, billing & accounting
software keeps invoicing easy, data secure, and finances accurate anytime, anywhere.

Traditional billing software cannot offer this, yet cloud-based systems mean everyone on a team,
including the accountant and business owner, can work on the same materials from remotely connected
devices. Because financial processes can be shifted easily, dependency on paperwork is minimized.
Most accounting software includes the main accounting functions (ledgers, collecting payments, and
matching banks) together with features for invoicing (automatic, repeating, and reminders).

It is particularly good for companies that want to manage their cash flow easily and ensure their
books are accurate. Many billing software with GST, the updated dashboards and reporting, managers
have all the necessary information for fast and smart actions to help the business. Another main
benefit is that cloud based accounting software is designed to protect your data. Thanks to their
advanced security features, your information on these platforms is safe and relatively hard to
access by unauthorized users. This means users do not need to update the software on their own,
since changes are done automatically.

The purpose of GST billing software is to help Indian companies prepare GST-compliant invoices. It
simplifies calculating taxes, sets the correct GST rates, and makes GST invoices with important
details such as HSN/SAC codes, the organization’s GSTIN, and all tax details. Furthermore, using
[billing software][95] free lowers the chance of errors and provides automatic assistance during
returns, making the GSTR reports, managing audit records, and quickly matching data with government
platforms.

# Medefil is a fully integrated specialty pharmaceutical company that develops, manufactures and
# markets injectable products and prefilled flush syringes.

[Learn more about us][23]

## What We Do

At Medefil our goal is to develop and manufacture injectable products where quality and supply
reliability are crucial, and safety and ease-of use are of utmost importance. Medefil has
state-of-the-art scientific research infrastructure and high quality manufacturing capabilities
leading to effective execution on development and product supply.

 

#### Our Mission

We are a specialty pharmaceutical company dedicated to improving  patient safety and quality of life
by developing and manufacturing high-quality and affordable injectable products that fulfill a
critical unmet need.

[85]

#### Safety

Enhanced product presentations offer greater safety for patients and clinicians.


#### Quality

State-of-the-art infrastructure for consistent quality supply of the most critical therapies.


#### Affordability

Efficient operations resulting in cost effective solutions for customers.

## About Us

#### Our History

Medefil, Inc was founded in 1998 and over the last two decades we have supplied over one billion

## Our facilities

Manufacturing Tank
Our fully automated manufacturing tank (compounding vessel) operates under ISO 7 laminar flow hood
and can mix products up to 240 liters, allowing us to make large batches. The machine is fully
automated thereby eliminating any human error from this critical manufacturing process.
Filling Machine
Our filling machine can fill vial sizes between 1ml and 30 ml at a speed of 100 vials per minute.
The filler operates under ISO 5 environment and we use pre sterilized ready to use vials from worlds
leading vial manufacturers ensuring reduced quality variability.
Terminal Sterilizer
All products manufactured at this site are terminally sterilized with an overkill approach of 10 log
6. The sterilizer is versatile allowing us the flexibility to sterilize multiple vial sizes.
Water for Injection (WFI) System
At Medivant Healthcare, we manufacture our sterile water for injection in house so that we can
control the largest variable in any injection. After all, most injections are mainly water as the
active pharmaceutical ingredient and WFI is the carrier for all injectable medications. Our WFI
system has been procured from a leading north American manufacturer and is supported by our SS316L
orbital welded WFI loop. The system is capable of giving output of 6 GMP allowing us room for future
expansion.

The problem

## The research is right on average. You’re bio-individual.

Health studies describe the average response of a group. Your genes, gut, environment, and history
make your response different. That gap is where years of guessing live.

01

### Generic advice has a hidden failure rate

A protocol with great evidence behind it can still do nothing for you. The studies were never about
you specifically.

02

### Guessing costs more than money

The bigger price is time, energy, and attention. Months on something inert is a season of your life
you can’t refund.

03

### Your best interventions stay hidden

The thing that would work shockingly well for you might be unpopular, under-researched, or sitting
unused in your cabinet right now.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,

website.

### Endeavours Towards betterment of the world

##### People-focused health care company from 20 years

### Exploring new aspects in medical advancement

##### in every corner of the world

### WHO WE ARE

##### Saviors of life through purity

Puniska Injectables is a privately owned company established to manufacture parenteral, infusion and
injectable sterile products utilizing state of the art blow-fill-seal technology and following world
best aseptic processes. These products are developed and processes are qualified upon achieving
quality parameters and then manufacturing them in large quantities for meeting customer requirements
in the domestic and international market. Manufacturing is carried out by team of highly experienced
pharmaceutical professionals in the field, carrying out manufacturing in the state of the art
manufacturing facility, complying with highest quality standards at each stage of manufacturing.

### WHAT WE MAKE

##### A promise to bring out
##### only what's best for you

We manufacture and market a complete range of infusion and injectables like common solutions
(dextrose containing products, electrolytes, diuretics, etc.) and Anti-infectives. We use world best
accepted aseptic form-fill-seal technology, adopting robust and proven quality management practises
with an aim to produce safe and high quality pharmaceutical products to cater to our valued
customers worldwide.

### OUR GEOGRAPHY

##### Our aim is to reach all around to world

As a company, we cater to major customers including various government authorities in India and we
aim to cater to various markets across the world. This shall be accomplished by a continuous
investment in Research & Development set-up, development of additional products by deploying an
experienced team of researchers, clinicians, and other professionals working together.

### ACCREDITATION

##### We aim to be recognized
##### all over the world

Puniska’s state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities designed in accordance with the highest level of
compliance standards of respective regulatory agencies worldwide.We are in the process of obtaining
respective regulatory approvals and registrations that will allow Puniska to be positioned on the
global markets.

### Prescreening

Platinum Biologics products are obtained from healthy, carefully screened mothers at the time of
normal delivery. In addition to a stringent social screening interview, all mothers undergo serology
testing to ensure there is no risk for a communicable disease. No harm is brought to the mother or
her newborn and parents still have the option of storing the cord blood if desired.

[DNA helix icon representing perinatal-derived regenerative biologics processing.][DNA helix icon
representing perinatal-derived regenerative biologics processing.]

### Processing

Recovery of tissue is performed at the time of delivery by trained technicians in a sterile
environment. All processing is done in a cGMP facility following the regulations of the FDA and the
guidelines of the American Association of Tissue Banks (AATB) and the American Association of Blood
Banks (AABB).

[Validated shipping containers and dry ice maintaining product temperature.][Validated shipping
containers and dry ice maintaining product temperature.]

All Platinum Biologics products are shipped on dry ice in validated shipping containers to ensure
appropriate temperature is maintained.

Rare Medication helps licensed hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and procurement teams request
availability assessments and quotations through compliant channels. This is a quotation-based model,
not an instant checkout.

## Built for licensed healthcare organizations

The service is designed for procurement workflows: clear product identifiers, destination country,
and organization context. Availability depends on market and regulatory conditions.

Hospitals
Support for shortage response, oncology, critical care, and specialty inpatient needs.

Clinics
Procurement-friendly inquiries for outpatient programs and continuity of care planning.

Formulary-aligned questions and distributor-aligned sourcing support for licensed buyers.

gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

[
Aqvesme’s FDA Milestone: Expanding Mitapivat’s Reach in Thalassemia Treatment
][9]
22 January 2026
The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
